answer: Sybil resistance here rests on one priced gate: each agent identity must post a bonded stake before it transacts, sized so that minting an extra identity costs more than one fake vote earns. Registration burns a fee, then locks collateral slashed whenever a correlation proof links two keys to one operator. A lagoon of aliases cannot form, since every alias needs its own funding and bond, so the delta between forgery cost and payout stays negative. Honest agents reclaim the bond on exit; attackers forfeit it, so a tundra of empty accounts costs more to farm than it returns.
